label: Train State
description: What the train is doing on the rail.

items.name: full-speed-pass
items.text: passing at full line speed, rails singing and ballast dust whipped into the slipstream

items.name: mountain-grade
items.text: curving up a mountain grade, the full length of the train visible around the horseshoe bend

items.name: snow-run
items.text: punching through fresh drifts, snow exploding off the plow in a white bow wave

items.name: night-yard
items.text: at rest in a freight yard under sodium floodlights, signal lamps red and green down the ladder tracks

items.name: station-dwell
items.text: paused at the platform with doors open, heat shimmer rising from beneath the car bodies

items.name: viaduct-crossing
items.text: crossing a tall stone viaduct, arches striding across the valley below

items.name: pantograph-arc
items.text: running dark territory after sundown, blue-white arcs flashing where the pantograph skates the catenary

items.name: desert-straight
items.text: running a dead-straight desert mainline to the vanishing point, heat mirage floating the distant rails
